subject: Next step: lock 30m product preview & SME nomination — three options
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Samira Patel <samira@helioshealth.com>, Tom O'Neill <tom.oneill@helioshealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Next step: lock 30m product preview & SME nomination — three options
Attachments: discovery-notes-Helios-20270905.pdf

Hi Samira / Tom —

Thanks again for the call this morning — great overview of your ingestion patterns and the latency targets you mentioned for the clinical search flow. I captured the key takeaways in the attached discovery notes (short bullet list + a couple of follow-ups).

Next step from our side is a 30-minute product preview + Q&A where we can show the generation and embedding latency behavior on a small sample, and have our infra SME walk through integration points. To make scheduling easy, please pick one of the three options below (all times are PT):

- Option A: Tue 9/07 — 10:00–10:30 PT
- Option B: Wed 9/08 — 14:00–14:30 PT
- Option C: Thu 9/09 — 11:30–12:00 PT

Ben (SE) and Priyom (Infra SME) will join from Redwood. Can you confirm who from Helios should be on the call (product owner, infra contact) and which option works best? I’ve attached a small .ics with those three windows too.

If none of the above fit, tell us two 30-min windows that work for you and we’ll adapt.

Thanks — look forward to locking this in.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com | (415) 555-0192
redwoodinference.com

On the agenda briefly: 10 min walkthrough, 10 min infra/ops Q&A, 10 min next-steps / mutual action plan.

From: Samira Patel <samira@helioshealth.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom O'Neill <tom.oneill@helioshealth.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Sep 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next step: lock 30m product preview & SME nomination — three options

Thanks Laura — the recap looks right and the attached notes are helpful.

Quick answers:
- We’ll want Product (me) and one Infra/Platform person — looping in Tom to nominate.
- Of the three, Option B (Wed 9/08 14:00 PT) is best for us.

Tom — can you confirm you (or someone from Platform) can join at 14:00 PT on 9/08? If not, flag a couple windows and we’ll pick another.

Also can you share any pre-read we should distribute to Platform? If you have a short checklist of what logs/traces you want available, we’ll prep those.

Best,
Samira Patel
Senior Product Manager — Data Platform
Helios Health
samira@helioshealth.com

Thanks Samira / Laura — I can make Option B (Wed 9/08 14:00 PT). I’ll be the Platform attendee. A couple quick asks from our side before the preview:

- Can Redwood share a two-slide summary of the infra integration points (auth, VPC/networking, KMS options)?
- If you plan to show live inference we’d like to understand the dataset you’ll use (to confirm PHI rules) — if it’s synthetic/mock data that’s fine.

I’ll put the time on my calendar now. If Redwood can send the two-slide infra summary and the calendar invite with the agenda that’ll help.

Attachments: redwood-infra-summary-2slides.pdf, redwood-proposed-times.ics

Quick prep notes:
- We will use synthetic patient-like vectors for the live demo; no PHI will be used.
- Priyom will cover tokenization/latency expectations for your short-context clinical search example.
- If you can share any specific sample queries ahead of time, we’ll tailor the demo to those.

Tom — thanks for confirming; Samira — can you confirm if Product wants a shorter internal pre-read? If not, we’ll stick to the 30-min format and save deeper integration for a follow-up workshop.

See you Wednesday — Ben
